visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young women are playing mahjong in a brightly lit indoor studio. One woman with long brown hair and glasses wears a grey top, while another wears a black off-the-shoulder top and a choker. The table is brown with various mahjong tiles scattered. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor alleyway with a light-colored brick wall. A woman in a white vest and beanie is talking to a friend in a pink hoodie. Suddenly, three men in dark suits and sunglasses approach; the leader grabs the friend in the pink hoodie. (3) Back indoors, the friend in the pink hoodie is seen slumped in a leather chair in a dimly lit room, guarded by a large man in a suit with grey hair. (4) At the mahjong table, the woman in the white vest continues her game. She picks up a pair of glasses from the table and looks through them, revealing glowing markings on the tiles. (5) The woman in the white vest rushes through a door into the room where the man in the suit is now lying on the floor. She looks distressed and calls out.
